subStrands.name: Office Definition, Functions, Departments and Equipment

objectives.description: The Office: definition; functions; layout; principles of office organisation (span of control, unity of control, unity of function); office procedures; sections of the office.
Departments in an Organisation: list of departments; functions of each department; organisational chart.

Office Equipment: meaning; types — manual (typewriter, perforator, stapling machine, duplicating machine) and electrical (typewriter, photocopier, shredding machine, computer, scanning machine, facsimile machine); uses and care of office equipment.
The Reception: meaning; duties of the receptionist; documents handled; qualities of a receptionist; procedures for handling telephone calls.
Office Documents: meaning; types (administrative, sales, stores, purchasing); uses; preparation of office documents.
Office Correspondence: meaning; types — memos, business letters, notice of meetings, minutes of meetings, reports, circulars.
Mail: types of mail (personal, official, urgent, confidential); classification (incoming and outgoing); procedures for handling incoming and outgoing mail.

Filing: definition; systems (vertical, lateral, electronic); classifications (alphabetical, chronological, numerical, geographical, alpha-numerical, subject); purposes; steps involved; filing equipment.

Communication: definition; importance; types (verbal — oral and written; non-verbal — visual, audio, audio-visual); methods/media (print and electronic); communication service providers (NIPOST, NITEL, media houses, satellite stations, internet, GSM).

Meetings: definition; purpose; types (statutory, emergency, board, management, AGM, staff, committee); procedure for conducting a meeting (agenda, chairman's opening, reading of minutes, adoption, matters arising, main business, AOB, adjournment); meeting terminologies; roles of chairman and secretary; writing the minutes.
Report Writing: meaning; types (short, long, investigative, routine/periodic); parts of a report; importance of report writing.
Information: definition; types; uses; sources; storage; qualities of good information (timeliness, accuracy, speed of delivery, usability, etc.).
